observations: Three photos show stacks of used car tires in a shop with tiled flooring.
Tires vary in tread depth and condition; some show significant wear, others appear more worn.
No visible brand or model markings are legible on any tire in any photo.
Tires are stacked vertically, some with sidewall labels partially visible but unreadable.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JI IKWE ANTHONY' is present on all photos.
No rims are visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: No brand or country of origin is visible on any tire in the photos. The claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tires may be damaged, cracked, or have hidden structural issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of sidewalls, treads, and inner walls of each tire, including inspection of any cuts, bulges, or cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unsafe or unusable, with reduced value.

risks.risk: Tires may be from a different brand or model than claimed, or may be counterfeit.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of sidewall labels showing brand, model, size, and manufacturing date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic or unbranded, with lower value.

risks.risk: Rims may be missing or damaged, as only tires are shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the rims attached to the tires, showing condition and any damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires only, with no rim included, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the sidewall labels on each tire to identify brand, model, and size.
Close-up photos of the tread and sidewalls of each tire to check for damage or wear.
Photos of the rims attached to the tires, showing condition and any damage.
Photos of the tires from multiple angles, including the inner walls and any visible cuts or bulges.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
